name: ocolta
description: Understand the categorical signals, confidence and priorities in an existing Ocolta document review. Find recoverable reviews linked to your purchase and compare their available summaries. Start a new document review in Ocolta; this connection does not upload documents, purchase reviews, return raw document text, verify bank accounts or decide eligibility. Recovery remains subject to the product’s time window.
